content: Yoobu u ɡɑri suɑ u nɛɛ,

content.text: nɑ yɛ̃ mɛ.
Amɔnɑ tɔnu u ko n dɛɛre Gusunɔn wuswɑɑɔ.
Gusunɔ ù n tɔnu ɡɑri konu nɔrɔbu (1.000) bikiɑ,
u ǹ wɑsi u wisi bɑɑ tiɑ.
Wiyɑ u bwisi kɑ dɑm kpuro mɔ.
Wɑrɑ u koo nùn seesi kpɑ yɛ̃ron wɑ̃ɑru tu dɑkɑɑ dɑ.
U rɑ ɡuunu yiiye subɑru sɔɔ,
kpɑ u nu suriri kɑ mɔru.
U rɑ de tem mu yĩiri sere mɛn sɔɔwɔ,
kpɑ mɛn ɡberebɑ bu wɔruku.
U rɑ sɔ̃ɔ woodɑ wɛ̃ u ku yɑri,
kpɑ u win yĩreru doke kperi sɔɔ.
Wi turowɑ u wɔllu tɛriɑ.
Mɑ u sĩimɔ nim kurenun wɔllɔ.
Wiyɑ u kperi bwese bwesekɑ tɑkɑ kuɑ, kɑ kperi swɑɑnu,
kɑ kperi yi yi wɑ̃ɑ sɔ̃ɔ yɛ̃sɑn nɔm dwɑru ɡiɑ.
U rɑ sɔm bɑkɑnu ko ni bɑ ǹ kpɛ̃ bu tubu.
U rɑ sɔm mɑɑmɑɑkiɡinu ko dɑbi dɑbinu.
Bɑɑ ù n doonɔ nɛn bɔkun di, nɑ ǹ nùn wɑsi.
Ù n mɑɑ sɑrɔ, nɑ ǹ tubu.
Ye u nɛnuɑ, wɑrɑ u koo nùn ye wɔrɑri.
Wɑrɑ u koo kpĩ u nùn sɔ̃ u nɛɛ, mbɑ ɑ mɔ̀ mɛ.
Gusunɔ ù n win mɔru seewɑ u ku rɑ ye yɔ̃rɑsie.
Win nɑɑsun temɔwɑ u rɑ yɑɑ ɡɔbɑ ye bɑ mɔ̀ Rɑhɑbun dɑm tɑɑre.
Nɛ mɑɑ ni, ɑmɔnɑ kon nùn wisi.
Gɑri yirɑ̀ kon ɡere win wuswɑɑɔ.
Bɑɑ nɑ̀ n ɡem mɔ, nɑ ǹ kpɛ̃ n nùn ɡɑ̃ɑnu wisi, wi, wi u sɑ̃ɑ nɛn siri kowo.
Suuruwɑ kon nùn kɑnɑ kɑ bɛɛrɛ.
Bɑɑ nɑ̀ n nùn kɑnɑ mɑ u mɑn wisɑ,
kɑ mɛ, nɑ ǹ nɑɑnɛ mɔ̀ n nɛɛ, u nɛn nɔɔ nuɑ.
Domi u mɑn wɔri nɡe woo ɡunɑ.
Mɑ u mɑn mɛɛrɑ dɑbinu kuɑ kɑm, nɑ ǹ ɡɑ̃ɑnu kue.
U ku rɑ de n wɛ̃siɑ,
mɑ u derɑ nɛn wɑ̃ɑrɑ sosiɑ.
Ǹ n dɑm ɡɑrin nɑ, wiyɑ u dɑm kpuro mɔ.
Ǹ n mɑɑ siribun ɡɑrin nɑ, wɑrɑ u koo kpĩ u nùn siribu soku.
Bɑɑ nɑ̀ n ɡem mɔ, kɑ mɛ, nɛn ɡere yɑ koo mɑn tɑɑrɛ wɛ̃.
Bɑɑ nɑ̀ kun tɑɑrɛ mɔ, u koo mɑn sɔ̃ɔsi mɑ nɑ sɑ̃ɑ durumɡii.
Bɑɑ mɛ nɑ ǹ tɑɑrɛ ɡɑɑ mɔ,
nɛn wɑ̃ɑrɑ kun mɑn nɛni,
nɑ tu tusɑ.
Kon kpĩ n ɡere n nɛɛ, ɡɑ̃ɑnu kpuro nu sɑ̃ɑwɑ tiɑ Gusunɔn mi.
Domi u rɑ tɔn kɔ̃so kɑ tɑɑrɛ sɑriruɡii kpeerɑsie.
Bɑrɑru ɡɑru tɑ̀ n tɑɑrɛ sɑriruɡii wɔri subɑru sɔɔ, tɑ ɡo,
Yinni Gusunɔ u rɑ n nùn yɛ̃ɛmɔwɑ nɔni swɑ̃ɑ te u wɑn sɔ̃.
Tem mù n wɔri tɔn kɔ̃son nɔmuɔ,
Yinni Gusunɔ u rɑ mɛn kpɑrobu wɔ̃koru kpɛ̃ɛwɑ.
Mɑ n kun wi, wɑrɑ u koo ye ko.
Wee, nɑ ǹ doo nɔɔru wɑ,
mɑ sere nɛn wɑ̃ɑrun tɔ̃rɑ doonɔ fuuku nɡe wi u dukɑ mɔ̀.
Tɑ sɑrɑmɔ nɡe ɡoo nimkuu si bɑ kuɑ kɑ ɡbĩi,
ǹ kun mɛ nɡe ɡunɔ bɑkeru te tɑ sɑrɑm wee tu yɑɑ so.
Nɑ̀ n nɛɛ, kon nɛn weeweenu deri n nɛn wuswɑɑ dɛɛrɑsiɑ,
kpɑ nɑ n nuku dobu mɔ,
nɑ rɑ nɑndewɑ nɛn wɑhɑlɑ yeni kpuron sɔ̃.
Domi nɑ yɛ̃ mɑ Yinni Gusunɔ kun mɑn ɡem wɛ̃ɛmɔ.
Bɑɑ ǹ n mɛren nɑ, nɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ tɑɑrɛɡii win mi.
Mbɑn sɔ̃nɑ ko nɑ n mɑɑ nùn sɔ̃ɔsimɔ mɑ nɑ dɛɛre.
Bɑɑ nɑ̀ n woburɑ kɑ ɡuru kpenun nim,
kpɑ n niɑ kɑ werem,
kɑ mɛ, u koo mɑn surewɑ pɔtɔkɔ sɔɔ,
kpɑ nɛn yɑ̃nun nuburu tu mɑn bwɛ̃rɑ yɔ̃.
Wee Gusunɔ kun sɑ̃ɑ tɔnu nɡe nɛ,
n sere nùn sɔ̃ n nɛɛ,
su dɑ siri yerɔ bu sun siriɑ.
Goo ù n dɑɑ wɑ̃ɑ wi u koo du bɛsɛn suunu sɔɔ
u sun yɑkiɑnɑ,
Gusunɔ u koo rɑɑ win bokuru yi te u kɑ mɑn soomɔ,
kpɑ u de nɔni swɑ̃ɑ te nɑ wɑɑmɔ mi, tu kpe.
Sɑɑ ye sɔɔ, nɑ ǹ mɑɑ bɛrum mɔ̀ n kɑ nùn ɡɑri ko.
Adɑmɑ n ǹ sɑ̃ɑ mɛ.

content: Yoobu u nɛɛ, Gusunɔ u nùn mɑrɑ u kɑ nùn kɑm koosiɑ
